{"filtered_reviews":[{"reviewer_country":null,"approval_status":"APPROVED","rating":"5","channel":"MANUAL","created_at":"2019-03-15 00:00:00","type":"SITE","reviewer_avatar":"https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/assets/srv0/yelp_styleguide/514f6997a318/assets/img/default_avatars/user_60_square.png","content":"I was visiting from out of town and wanted a dancing fix, so I decided to drop by on a Thursday night. I was a little nervous about going to a set of what seemed to be advertised as four 45 minute beginner-friendly drop-in lessons, because as someone who does a fair amount of casual social dancing, I was seeking more than a basic intro to dancing to the beat and connecting with a partner. I am so glad I decided to show up! Terry has a strong focus on technique, which I often wish I could get more of in my casual social dance contexts. I was the only person who showed up for the first lesson, and I essentially got a 45 minute private lesson on West Coast Swing technique. This was followed by a 45 minute rumba class, which two other couples showed up for. The class moved a little slowly for me as someone who dances rumba socially (I wanted more technique pointers more quickly), but I ultimately got a lot of new technique information out of it, at least some of which I hope to remember and apply in social dance contexts.The latter part of the evening was a less useful learning experience for me, as Terry spent a fair amount of time working one-on-one with a couple on more advanced tango material, and I did not have sufficient tango experience to participate. This was somewhat disappointing, as I had expected additional beginner-friendly lessons based on the posted description of the evening. (Listening in on the lesson was somewhat useful, as Terry provided some tips to the couple for doing a contra check, which is something I've had trouble doing well when dancing waltz. It would have been more useful, however, if I had had the opportunities to try out what he was describing.) At the end of the evening there was about a half hour of learning/dancing a line dance, which was somewhat interesting, but it happened rather quickly without much explanation or technique instruction, and thus wasn't as satisfying as the earlier part of the evening.Overall, the experience was well worth the $12 I paid. The evening was more technique-heavy than basically any other dance lesson I've been to, which I really appreciated! I look forward to coming back again the next time I am in town.","reviewer_city":null,"is_manual_review":false,"reviewer_name":"Lynn H.","product_id":null,"reply_email_flag":false,"reply":null,"external_platform_id":"YkST9TNlIEfjOLn3DEcxKQ"},{"reviewer_country":null,"approval_status":"APPROVED","rating":"5","channel":"MANUAL","created_at":"2017-05-09 00:00:00","type":"SITE","reviewer_avatar":"https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/photo/gCcJRCxnFUEJMFGeVrM-JA/60s.jpg","content":"Terry helped me and my fiancé choreograph and learn a simple dance for our wedding last summer.  Neither of us were eager participants but he made it fun and simple!  (I mean really simple - he sometimes had to eliminate half the parts of a move so we would get it.)  He also helped me and my dad prep a father daughter dance in two short, last minute sessions.  It was a quirky experience to take dance lessons in the church! In many ways it helped us feel more comfortable - it was kind of disarming. I did see some other people practicing much more elaborate dances, so I'm sure if you have time he could craft something wonderful for you.  But if you're like us and just trying to avoid falling on your face during your first dance, they can help with that, too!","reviewer_city":null,"is_manual_review":false,"reviewer_name":"Emily H.","product_id":null,"reply_email_flag":false,"reply":null,"external_platform_id":"GbNVb49yxHaP533CsEvIZQ"},{"reviewer_country":null,"approval_status":"APPROVED","rating":"5","channel":"MANUAL","created_at":"2017-03-15 00:00:00","type
